Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game character animation sprite atlas with native transparent alpha.
Input images: Image 1 is Bo identity/style reference: use ONLY turquoise Chinese dragon, ignore crane/red panda. Image 2 is approved story reference: match Bo walking away in its upper left scene.
Primary request: render ONE 4-column by 2-row sprite sheet containing EIGHT consecutive frames of a real looping biped walk, ordered left-to-right top row then bottom row. All eight figures are the SAME Bo at SAME scale, SAME fixed three-quarter REAR camera, walking away toward upper-right while remaining in-place in each cell. Always show back of head/coral mane and back/satchel; never turn around between frames. Soft premium hand-painted storybook 3D illustration matching references. Turquoise scales with subtle gold decoration, coral flowing mane and tail tip, gold curled horns and toe claws, ivory belly underside/tail underside, brown leather crossbody satchel with little gold flower clasp and red tassel. Preserve full thick curled tail. Entire figure in every cell.
Layout: exact 4 equal columns x 2 equal rows, generous transparent gutter, no dividers. Target overall aspect 8:5 (e.g. 1536x960), each cell portrait 4:5. Each frame occupies about 90% cell height and centered horizontally. Align planted foot bottoms on identical ground baseline. No cast shadows. All content isolated with actual alpha transparency including around whiskers and tail, no background.
Animation phase sequence: 1 left foot heel contact forward, right foot trailing toe support, right arm forward and left arm back; 2 left foot planted flat bearing weight, right heel lifted; 3 left foot planted while right knee bends and swings past planted leg; 4 right leg extends toward next contact, left heel begins lift; 5 right foot heel contact forward, left trailing toe support, left arm forward and right arm back; 6 right foot planted flat bearing weight, left heel lifted; 7 right foot planted while left knee bends and swings past it; 8 left leg extends toward next left contact. Show clear alternating independent legs, knees, feet and natural opposing arm swing plus subtle tail counterbalance, coherent anatomy and volume. Frame 8 loops naturally to frame 1. Keep actual torso and head volume consistent. This must be genuine articulated walking motion across frames, not one static pose translated/bobbed. No extra characters, no lettering, no text, no numbers, no decorative marks, no floor, no frame, no gridlines, no checkerboard.
